propositions: Event-derivation reader must compute five agent-process metrics (attempts_per_ticket, first_pass_rate, rework_within_days, reopen_recovery, revert_recovery) over durable ticket event store including compaction-retired events.

Metrics requiring per-event or multi-occurrence data (attempts, rework windows, reopen counts) must read raw event files sorted via event_sort_key and filtered via is_active_event; metrics needing only terminal state (first_pass_rate, revert_recovery) must read compiled reduce_ticket state.

Reader must reuse existing reducer helpers (sort keys, retired-event handling, snapshot filtering) rather than reinvent file operations; metrics return None for empty ranges and 0 for zero qualifying events.

Unit tests must verify: two distinct sessions yield attempts_per_ticket==2; closed→open→closed within 7 days counts in rework_within_days(7) but 10-day gap does not; first_pass_rate excludes reopened tickets; revert_recovery counts STATUS/COMMITS reverts but not COMMENT reverts; retired events are included.
Metrics must register in registry.py with source='structural' and confidence='high' as authoritative; escalation and cross-agent handoff metrics are explicitly out-of-scope and report Unavailable.
